item.title: Sudan accuses Ethiopia of allowing RSF drone launches from its territory
item.description: Sudan accused Ethiopia of allowing the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) to launch drones from its territory. What does this allegation reveal about the RSF's military capabilities and foreign backing? FRANCE 24 spoke to Ali Mahmoud Ali, a Sudan researcher at ACLED, the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project, which monitors conflicts worldwide. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Ethiopian families fleeing conflict face difficulties with food access
item.description: A renewed conflict in Ethiopia has led to the displacement of thousands of civilians. But after years of war in the country and heavy budget cuts, humanitarian organisations have all but left many of the camps for internally displaced people, leaving many without food or health care. FRANCE 24's correspondent Tom Canetti reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Dozens dead and missing after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid centre
item.description: The death toll from a Russian bombing of an aid distribution point in Ukraine's southeastern Zaporizhzhia region on Monday has risen to 42, with dozens still missing, officials said, in one of the deadliest strikes on civilians this year. The attack came a day ​after a brief ‌US-brokered local ceasefire expired and less than a week before the United States is due to bring together Ukrainian and Russian delegations ⁠in Abu Dhabi for talks on ending the war, now in its fifth year. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Zelensky in Spain for talks with world leaders as Kyiv seeks to strengthen air defences
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky made a surprise visit to Madrid on Wednesday to drum up fresh military support against Russia during a summit of Latin American leaders in Spain. Madrid is hosting a two-day summit of the Ibero-American Community, a 22-nation group of Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries where support for Ukraine since Russia's 2022 invasion has divided opinion. FRANCE 24's Kyiv correspondent, Emmanuelle Chaze reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: After midterm stinging defeat, Trump is left to weigh his next move in Iran war
item.description: As he takes stock of his Republican Party's midterm drubbing, US President Donald Trump now faces the difficult question of what to do about his unpopular war against Iran. Trump acknowledged the war affected the midterms, suggesting voters were frustrated by surging gas prices that have been a byproduct of the more than 8-month-old conflict. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Cyberattack hits French blood bank site, no blood products compromised
item.description: A cyberattack on several blood banks tried to raise temperatures to extremely high levels but was thwarted before it could do any damage to blood products or samples, French authorities said. The incident comes after supermarkets in a number of European countries reported this week that their fridges and freezers warmed up after they were remotely taken over, resulting in tons of spoiled food at a total cost of millions of euros. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24
